figmaBuildPlan.tokenProfileHint: Use default Techjockey typography tokens for business software: Plus Jakarta Sans for headings, Inter for body. Use light theme with brand-primary hero treatment and orange accent CTA. Trust proof should be logo-first and prominent.

sections.variantHint: sticky full-width top strip with support/trust microcopy and a compact CTA
sections.notes: Fixed for entire page. Keep always visible. Include brand-colored bar, concise delivery/support trust line, and a small CTA button aligned right. Do not use empty space.

sections.variantHint: split hero with text-left and product-support visual context on right; light theme with strong brand accent
sections.notes: Must include headline, subheadline, supporting line, primary CTA, secondary CTA. Use 20-word hero headline sizing rule for 16+ words: 36px, semibold. Keep brand-like but light-themed. Right side should support the story without creating black/empty space; if no UI screenshot exists, use a branded support-themed abstract/product card composition rather than a blank area.

sections.variantHint: logo-first badge row with award badge and customer count stat
sections.notes: Dominant trust signal. Use light grey section background. Place award badge, trusted-by statement, and 100,000+ businesses count in a centered horizontal row with dividers. Make logos/badges more visually prominent than text.

Use the four provided features only: Omnichannel Support, Ticket Management, AI Assistance (Zia), Workflow Automation. Do not nest a grid inside a grid. Use a single readable 2-column desktop card layout with white cards, border, and icon area at top.

Second feature section focused on AI assistance: AI-Powered Responses, Sentiment Analysis, Auto Tagging & Insights, Conversation Intelligence. Keep as a separate section with a clear headline and supporting description. Use same card system for consistency.

Display the provided integrations as compact tiles or pills with consistent spacing: CRM Integration, Collaboration Tools, Telephony, E-commerce Platforms, Automation Tools. Keep readable and avoid over-complicated nesting.

sections.variantHint: feature cards or split cards for customization capabilities
sections.notes: Use the provided customization headline and description. Only include supported feature items from the input. If the content is truncated, do not invent missing features; instead render only available items and leave the section bounded to known data.

sections.variantHint: centered CTA band with primary and secondary actions
sections.notes: Add a dedicated CTA strip before footer. Must not be omitted. Use a light brand-tinted background and repeat primary CTA. Keep concise and conversion-focused.

sections.variantHint: simple marketplace footer with product, support, and policy links
sections.notes: Keep lightweight and functional. Include standard Techjockey footer structure; do not add unsupported promotional sections.

figmaExecutionNotes: Keep the top strip sticky across the full page and ensure the page is fully scrollable from the hero downward.
Use a single feature card system for all feature sections; do not create nested grids inside grids.
Maintain light theme throughout with brand-accent hero, white feature sections, and light-grey trust separation.
Do not add a form section because the provided content does not support one.
Do not add testimonials, pricing/cart, or news because those sections are not supported by the input.
On mobile, stack hero content, convert feature sections to single column, keep CTA strip visible, and preserve the sticky top strip behavior.
Ensure section order follows the input-supported design intent: sticky strip, hero, trust, product/features, integrations, customization, CTA strip, footer.

heroStrategy.headline: Deliver Exceptional Customer Support with Zoho Desk
heroStrategy.subheadline: Streamline customer service, manage tickets efficiently, and deliver seamless support experiences across every channel.
floatingChips: Digital License Delivered to Your Email
heroStrategy.designNote: Use an unexpected layered hero: a full-width orange-led mesh gradient background with a large left text column and an oversized floating dashboard composition centered-right, partially spilling beyond the hero frame. Build depth with subtle grid lines, soft shadow cards, and indigo highlights for Zia AI moments. Keep the hero bold and highly readable with H1 at 64px+ and a compact trust band under the CTA. No static centered layout; make the product UI feel like a premium, living workspace rather than a generic screenshot. Add decorative orbs and thin connector lines in the hero, then alternate the following feature sections left/right with one dark section for contrast.

repetitionBreakers: Start with a high-contrast split hero, then switch immediately to a compact logo trust band.
Use a 3-step process next to reduce perceived effort before expanding into proof.
Alternate between editorial split panels and denser utility sections so consecutive blocks never feel structurally identical.
Make the first product block visual-first, the next more text-led, and the final product block more modular.
End with a pricing card, testimonial support, and a centered lead form to create a stronger close.
blueprint.pageTitle: Zoho Desk | Deliver Exceptional Customer Support
blueprint.metaDescription: Discover Zoho Desk customer support software for omnichannel ticket management, AI assistance, workflow automation, and faster resolutions for support teams.

sections.backgroundTreatment: solid-brand-block with subtle dashboard-line texture and high-contrast white text
sections.designNote: Hero must answer what it is, who it is for, and what to do next. Keep it content-first but dynamic: large headline, concise support-led subheadline, a short benefit chip row, and a clean product dashboard mockup on the right. CTA text must be exactly 'Get started' and use the accent color at full opacity. Mobile CTA full-width.

Use 3-6 recognizable customer logos as the dominant proof band. Since the input does not provide named logos, convert this into a strong trust row with logo placeholders plus the 'Trusted by 100,000+ Businesses Globally' message and the customer count. Keep it compact, not marquee-based.

Introduce a 3-step process under 60 seconds: capture tickets, automate routing, resolve faster. Use three concise cards with a small visual step indicator. This should reduce friction before deeper proof and must not feel like a generic SaaS explainer.

Show industry-style proof immediately after the process. Keep the dominant proof type as logos, supported by the trust statement and a compact outcome strip. The section should feel more credible than promotional.

First product block should focus on the click-driving core: omnichannel support, ticket management, AI assistance, and workflow automation. Use a split panel with a dashboard-style visual on one side and a concise feature list on the other. Keep it more visual than text-heavy.

featurePresentation.primaryFeatureTitle: Make Smarter Support Decisions with Zia AI

sections.designNote: Second product block should switch pattern to tabs with a live preview panel to handle the 5+ AI-related feature depth without using a flat static grid. Tabs: AI-powered responses, sentiment analysis, auto-tagging, conversation intelligence. This section should feel more analytical and product-deep.

Third product block should feel operational and extensible. Use accordion sections paired with a right-side integration or admin UI visual. Include integrations, layouts, blueprints, extensions, and help center. This pattern should contrast with the prior tabbed block.

Keep pricing simple and highly legible. Use one centered highlighted card rather than comparison tables because the input only provides one plan. Include the feature-inclusive summary, supported devices, and a single CTA button labeled exactly 'Get started'.

With 4+ testimonials available, use a 3-card grid on desktop and stacked cards on mobile. Select the most outcome-rich quotes that emphasize speed, multichannel handling, automation, and self-service reduction. Keep this section supportive rather than salesy.

Final conversion block should be a centered floating card with minimal fields and a single orange CTA labeled exactly 'Get started'. Position it as 'See it in action' energy, not a hard signup wall. Mobile CTA full-width.

blueprint.designPersonality: Bright, structured, and highly dependable. It should feel like a premium B2B marketplace landing page for a support platform: strong logo trust, clear content hierarchy, orange conversion energy, calm white surfaces, and polished product-led storytelling.
blueprint.imageryDirection: Use a clean product dashboard mockup with inbox, tickets, SLA, and AI assist panels on the right side of the hero. Trust should be reinforced with a dominant logo strip, customer count band, and compact proof chips. Feature sections should use simple icon-led cards with short support-state illustrations, not decorative marketing clutter.

referenceMap.cardStyle: Utility-first content blocks with minimal decoration; no glassmorphism, no elevated promotional cards, and no visible card-heavy grid system in the reference layout.

referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Long-form stacked product storytelling using repeated feature sections with headline, description, and multi-item feature lists; suitable for alternating informational blocks and progressive disclosure without tabs/accordions.
referenceMap.formPattern: Prominent lead form placed directly beneath the hero, using a card-like container and multiple hidden tracking fields; structure suggests a conversion-first capture form with low-friction top-of-page placement.

designStrategy.reasoning: Zoho Desk is a solution-aware B2B help desk product, so the page should move visitors quickly from understanding to action with a lead-gen focus. Because the strongest trust cue requested is logos, the strategy should prioritize logo-led proof above testimonials or badge-heavy framing. The content is long and feature-rich, so the layout should stay vertically readable and editorial rather than complex or card-saturated. A centered, text-led hero fits the reference pattern and avoids right-side media, while a sticky top strip and strong CTA support consistent conversion throughout the page. The tone should feel efficient and safe, reflecting a reliable cloud support platform for business teams.
